title: What if I withdraw money from my IRA? | Internal Revenue Service
text: Skip to main content What if I withdraw money from my IRA? More In News Working Families Tax Cuts News releases Tax relief in disaster situations Topics in the news Fact sheets IRS statements and announcements IRS Tax Tips IRS guidance Multimedia center Tax articles to share Posters to share Generally, early withdrawal from an individual arrangement account (IRA) prior to age 59½ is subject to being included in gross income plus a 10 percent additional tax penalty. There are exceptions to the 10 percent penalty, such as using IRA funds to pay your medical insurance premium after a job loss. For more information, see Hardships, early withdrawals and loans .
